Mod.Name: Double Input Bugfix (and menu input Qol)
Mod.Description:
BE GONE double input! May you never darken FF7 PC's door again!!
Fix is enabled by default, you can just play once the mod is enabled.
Uses an unused flag in FF7 PC's code to prevent all input acting like key repeat (the cause of DI).
Im in qhimm and "FF7 Speedruns and Research" discords if you want to find me and ask questions.
The bugfix is now part of the game since the 2026 rerelease.
Ping me in discord (@_dig_) if you encounter any unexpected or undesired behaviour. I have an avatar of Vageta with a pink shirt like below.
